sections.body: Nicotine (in cigarettes and most vapes) is highly addictive. Teenage brains are still developing, which makes addiction more likely and can affect attention and learning.
Vapes are not harmless: they can contain nicotine and other chemicals, and many are marketed with sweet flavours to attract young people.
Alcohol and other drugs can affect judgement, memory, mental health and safety, and many are illegal for young people.
If you're worried about yourself or a friend, talk to a trusted adult or health professional. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

quiz.q: Why is nicotine especially risky for teenagers?
options: The developing brain becomes addicted more easily
hints: What's still developing during the teenage years?
Learning new skills is easier for young brains, and unfortunately, so is getting hooked.
quiz.explain: Teen brains are still developing, which makes nicotine addiction more likely.

quiz.q: Why are sweet-flavoured vapes a concern?
options: They can attract young people to an addictive product
hints: Who do candy flavours appeal to?
Toys in cereal boxes are aimed at children. Who might sweet vape flavours be aimed at?
quiz.explain: Sweet flavours appeal to young people and can draw them into nicotine addiction.
